pages.text: A $(item)Guild Ledger$() marks a workshop for every craft: the forge, the tannery, the weaving room and the woodshop. Each craft's stations must be within 7 blocks of it across and 4 up or down. Read the ledger to see what each craft has and needs.
pages.title: One Ledger

pages.text: Every craft works like the forge:$(li)$(bold)Prepare$() the raw material.$(li)$(bold)Soak$() it in a vat. The liquid sets its ★, as heating sets an ingot's.$(li)$(bold)Work$() it at the bench. The minigame decides whether it survives.$(li)$(bold)Craft$() parts and gear from it.
pages.title: The Pattern

pages.text: Each workshop has three levels: the basic stations (up to ★3), the first upgrade (★5), and both (★7). A vat won't take a liquid better than its workshop can work, and the bench refuses a piece above the workshop or your skill.$(br2)Decoration that suits the craft widens its sweet spots a little.
pages.title: Levels and ★
